id.description: A UUID string identifying this hog flow.

include_globals.description: Comma-separated top-level keys of the triggering payload to return in full, e.g. 'event,person'. Pass 'all' for the whole payload. Omitted, the response stays bounded and describes the payload in 'invocation_globals_summary' instead. The payload holds a raw event with person properties, groups and parked flow state, so ask only for the keys you need.
